title: UHF-Band Low Gain Antennas (LGA) and Radio Frequency Distribution Unit (UHF LGA & RFDU)
description:
The Mars Sample Return – Earth Return Orbiter (ERO) is one of three European Space Agency (ESA) contributions to the NASA/JPL led Mars Sample Return Campaign, which aims to return soil and atmospheric samples from the Mars surface to Earth by 2031.
ERO is foreseen for launch in 2026.

Further information concerning the Mars Sample Return campaign and the Earth Return Orbiter mission can be found on the Agency’s website here:
https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Human_and_Robotic_Exploration/Exploration/Mars_sample_return

The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the contractor for the MSR-ERO UHF- band Low Gain Antennas (UHF LGAs) and Radio Frequency Distribution Unit (UHF RFDU) it in accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.

The UHF LGAs and RFDU (UHF band Low Gain Antennas and Radio Frequency Distribution Unit) shall comprise:
-	Two UHF Low Gain antennas (named “UHF ANT” or “UHF LGA”), one located on –X side (UHF ANT1) and one on +Y side (UHF ANT2) of the ERO S/C. 
-	A Radio Frequency distribution units (UHF RFDU) comprising two RF switches and a set of 8 coaxial cables 
-	Ancillaries (Dust caps, RF loads)
Note: UHF transceiver is not part of the LGA/RFDU procurement

The main function of the UHF LGAs:
•	Signal radiation, i.e. conversion from guided transmission (coaxial I/F) to radiated waveform in UHF band forward link frequency band (only for ANT1)
•	Signal reception, i.e. conversion from radiated waveform to guided transmission (coaxial I/F) in UHF band return link frequency band (for both antennas)

The main function of the UHF Radio Frequency Distribution is to ensure: 
•	the transmit routing of the high power RF signal from the UHF-band Transceivers to the UHF-band antennas 
•	the receive routing of the RF signal from the UHF-band antennas to the UHF-band Transceivers

The UHF LGAs and RFDU shall operate in the following bands:
• UHF-Band Forward Link (Orbiter to Mars Asset) : 428 MHz – 450 MHz
• UHF-Band Return Link (Mars Asset to Orbiter) : 387 MHz – 410 MHz

Ziel von CODE-DE 2 sind die Schaffung und der Betrieb einer Plattform für die Bereitstellung und die Verarbeitung von Erdbeobachtungsdaten. Asukaslehti on Vantaan kaupungin julkaisema viranomaistiedote, jonka pitäisi tavoittaa kaikki kotitaloudet. Lehti on tuotettu sisällöllisesti kaupungin viestinnässä. Hankinta koostuu Vantaan kaupungin asukaslehden nelivärisen painetun lehden rotaatiopainotyöstä sekä osoitteettomasta jakelusta. Lehdestä painetaan vuositasolla 2–4 eri laajuista (20–48 sivua) julkaisua. Jakelu koskee kaikkia sopimuskaudella Vantaan kuntarajojen sisäpuolella sijaitsevia kotitalouksia ja Vantaan kaupungin virastoja, laitoksia ja asiakaspalvelupisteitä. Jakelu tapahtuu etukäteen sovittuna viikonpäivinä. Sopimus on kestoltaan 24 kuukautta ja sopimusta voidaan jatkaa kahdella yhden vuoden optiolla.

description: Over the last few years schemes based on minimal kinetic models for the Boltzmann equation are becoming increasingly popular as a reliable alternative over conventional Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) techniques. Due to the flexibility afforded by its close connection to the kinetic theory recent research has led to major improvements, including consistent models for aerothermodynamics andhighly compressible flow in low gravity operating conditions.Lattice Boltzmann solver avoids the traditionally time consuming meshing process by means of a particle-based discretization approach to the Boltzmann equation. The solver features a unique collision operator implemented in central-moment space that increases the order of the method (4th order for spatial and 2nd for temporal scales), the stability in the vanishing viscosity limit and the Galilean invariance. The code does not require stabilization and is uniquely suited for compressible flow.
